header.title: Polished design, fuzzy pitch
header.subtitle: Your page looks credible, but the hero copy makes people work too hard to understand the offer.

summary_panel.one_liner: The page looks credible, but the hero copy is too vague to explain what the product actually does in 5 seconds.
top_3_problems: Hero headline is vague and outcome-light
Primary CTA is generic and weakly matched to intent
Differentiation is buried under feature language
summary_panel.cta_hint: Start with the hero headline + CTA. That is your fastest conversion lift.

issue_cards.title: Your hero headline hides the product
issue_cards.problem: The hero headline does not clearly say what the product is or who it is for.
issue_cards.why_it_hurts: Visitors cannot quickly self-qualify, which increases bounce risk before they reach your stronger sections.
issue_cards.fix: State the product category, audience, and primary outcome directly in the hero headline.
issue_cards.example_rewrite: Collect and analyze customer feedback automatically so product teams can ship better features faster.

issue_cards.title: CTA says nothing about the next step
issue_cards.problem: The primary CTA is generic and does not communicate what happens next.
issue_cards.why_it_hurts: Generic CTAs create friction because users must guess the commitment level and outcome.
issue_cards.fix: Replace the CTA with a specific action that matches buyer intent and reduces ambiguity.

issue_cards.title: Benefits are broad, not differentiated
issue_cards.problem: The page leans on broad feature claims but does not explain why this is better than alternatives.
issue_cards.why_it_hurts: Without clear differentiation, visitors compare you on price or leave to keep researching.
issue_cards.fix: Add a clear 'why us' statement with a concrete differentiator (speed, setup time, data sources, accuracy, or workflow fit).
issue_cards.example_rewrite: Connect Slack, Intercom, and email in 10 minutes, then get deduplicated feedback themes your PMs can act on the same day.

issue_cards.title: You leave buying questions unanswered
issue_cards.problem: Common buyer objections (setup effort, integrations, pricing fit, data quality) are not handled early.
issue_cards.why_it_hurts: Visitors with interest still hesitate because they cannot answer basic purchase-risk questions from the page.

evidence.value: No visible FAQ or risk-reversal near pricing/CTA sections

issue_cards.fix: Add a short objection-handling block near the CTA covering setup time, integrations, and trial expectations.

issue_cards.title: Mobile hero is doing too much before the CTA
issue_cards.problem: On mobile, the hero text wraps into a dense block and the primary CTA appears low in the viewport.
issue_cards.why_it_hurts: Mobile users get less immediate clarity and may not see the action quickly enough to convert.

evidence.value: Primary CTA not fully visible on initial mobile viewport without scrolling

issue_cards.fix: Reduce hero copy length, tighten spacing, and move the CTA higher (or add a sticky mobile CTA).

items.note: The page hints at the value but does not clearly define the product in the hero.
It appears aimed at product teams, but the hero does not name them directly.
Short and punchy, but too abstract to carry first-impression clarity.
Visible CTA exists, but wording is generic and low-specificity.
Benefits are implied, but clear differentiation is not stated early.
Some logos/testimonials are present, but impact would improve with quantified outcomes.
The page flows logically and is mostly scannable on desktop.
Too little risk-reduction messaging near conversion points.
Usable, but hero density and CTA placement weaken first-screen performance.

quick_wins_section.title: Quick Wins
quick_wins_section.subtitle: 30 minutes or less
items: Rewrite the hero headline to name the product and target user explicitly.
Change the primary CTA from 'Get Started' to a specific action with clear next step.
Add a one-line differentiator under the hero subheadline.
Add a compact FAQ/risk-reversal block near the main CTA.

positives_section.title: What's Working
